name: Carol Fraser
reviewNotes:
Her former Long Island Swing Syndicate site (liswingsyndicate.com) is now a parked domain; no current website recorded.

Directory research 2026-10-04: New finding: since LISS closed (end of 2025), Carol runs Triple Step Swing (triplestepswing.com). The site itself does not print her name; the link comes from the group's Meetup page (owned by Triple Step Swing) quoting LISS's handover note. Website, socials and email are Triple Step Swing's (her own branded school), so a logo is included. No photo used: the site's photos are unnamed (one has a photographer watermark, one looks like stock), so I could not confirm any shows Carol. Lindy Hop could be added to her styles (Triple Step Swing focuses on Lindy Hop); the owner may also want an organizer entry for Triple Step Swing. An old allbiz listing gives a Syosset phone for LISS (closed) - not recorded.
description: Carol Fraser is a longtime swing dance teacher who runs Triple Step Swing, a Long Island group offering Lindy Hop and swing classes, private lessons and social dances; recent class series met in Syosset. She also usually teaches the 4th-Tuesday swing lesson at Swing Dance Long Island's dances at the Huntington Moose Lodge in Greenlawn.

logo.alt: Triple Step Swing logo: the letters TSS in tilted pink block letters with an orange outline

evidence.note: Meetup group (Hicksville area) carries the Long Island Swing Syndicate's closing note: LISS closed at the end of 2025 and Carol Fraser and her new organization Triple Step Swing took over; it points to triplestepswing.com.
Triple Step Swing's contact page lists Long Island, NY, hello@triplestepswing.com, and links to its Instagram, Facebook and Meetup group.
Facebook page "Triple Step Swing" (dance studio/school) with the same email and website; it posted a 3-week summer swing lesson series in Syosset, NY.
Swing Dance Long Island lists an Oct 27, 2026 swing lesson with Carol Fraser plus Halloween costume dance at its Tuesday dances.
Huntington Arts Council listing for SDLI at the Huntington Moose Lodge says Carol Fraser usually teaches a more advanced swing lesson on the 4th Tuesday.
Older bio (Dance Manhattan, closed 2014): swing and balboa teacher and competition champion who later led the Long Island Swing Syndicate in Syosset.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: meetup.com, triplestepswing.com, facebook.com, sdli.org.
